content.summary: An adult cartographer finds a route card whose lighthouse diagram creates an unresolved question. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: Exactly three child characters and one attic persist. + The photograph visibly precedes the key and opening. + The chest opens exactly once. + The family relationship is supported by the visible label. + The final state accounts for all three children and the open collection.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult cartographer beside a ferry while one folded route card blows toward a bench. She walks two steps, lifts the same card once and keeps the ferry behind her. Reveal one faded lighthouse diagram on the card, then return to her restrained uncertain look with card and ferry registered.
